gap: By default, the keyboard focus indicator is the ripple or a background tint, and its contrast can fall below 3:1
workaround: Enable `focusVisible` in your theme — see below

gap: Some default palette colors fall short of contrast minimums

affected.note: `error` on a dark Paper with elevation 2 or more

workaround: Override the affected palette entries. In dark mode, set a lighter `error.main`, or keep `error` text on a surface with elevation 0 or 1. Elevation does not help the label of a `filled` TextField

gap: The selected state of colored Toggle Buttons is conveyed almost entirely by hue
workaround: Add a non-color cue to the selected state, such as an icon

gap: Dynamic state changes are not announced

workaround: Show it only while an operation is in flight

gap: A focused button that turns `loading` loses keyboard focus to the page
workaround: Move focus to a nearby element before you set `loading`, and back when it ends
